title: First readers, i
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Monday. The comments section is a place now. Six stick figures at the back of the panel, in a row, like a jury. Wood draws a strip in front of them and they say 'more dog.'

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at the table. BARNABY. At the back: six STICK FIGURES in a row, watching him draw.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man drawing at a garage table with a small dog beside him while six crude stick figures stand in a row at the back of the panel watching

panels.composition: The strip on the pad: Wood and Gully at the counter. No dog in it.
props: the pad: a strip with no dog

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a drawing pad showing a four-panel strip of two men at a counter with no dog in it

panels.composition: The chorus. Six balloons. All the same.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, six crude stick figures each with a small speech balloon saying the same two words

panels.composition: Wood adding the dog to panel four. Under the counter. Where he was anyway. The chorus, satisfied, sitting down.
props: the pad, with the dog now

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man adding a small dog under a counter in the last panel of his strip while six stick figures behind him sit down satisfied, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: 'more dog.' Added to panel four, where he was anyway.
